stories.text: 🪦 FRESH OBITUARY: Joe's Scary Team has been laid to rest (14.72 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy vs Mr. Action Jackson, playoff odds win/loss: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy 58%/17%, Mr. Action Jackson 78%/40%.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Claremont In Yo Stace! vs The Mahomies. Playoff odds with a win / loss: Claremont In Yo Stace! 88% / 55%, The Mahomies 34% / 5.6%.
✅ CLINCHED: Brock You Like a Hurricane has locked up the #1 seed and a bye.
🏈 100-YARD RUSH: Ruffing the Passer ripped off a 26-yard run last week, 29% → 55% playoff odds. Hit the hole and never looked back.

🤝 HINDSIGHT DEPT.: 5 weeks ago we said The Mahomies should get Bo Nix and Parker Washington from Ramosverse. Since: Bo Nix and Parker Washington 138.84 pts, Devaughn Vele and Jeremiyah Love 40.40 pts.
🎯 TWO WINS: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy: 68% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 14% with none (now 43%).
📈 LINE MOVE: NYG @ IND: IND −2.5 at open, NYG −6.5 now. News: "Colts' Alec Pierce: 'Definitely a chance' to return from heel injury this season"
🏈 6 matchups are still up for grabs, and Claremont In Yo Stace! vs The Mahomies (The Mahomies 55%) is the tightest.
📝 REPORT CARDS ARE OUT: Brock You Like a Hurricane A (scoring A+, record A+); Kirbo Crushers D- (record F, scoring F).
🥶 Kirbo Crushers has dropped 3 straight. Can they snap it against Gibb it to Me Baby?
🕰️ Hindsight swap: If Claremont In Yo Stace! and Gibb it to Me Baby had swapped Warren for Williams and Judkins back in Week 1, both would be ahead.
📈 Ruffing the Passer was down to 0.5% against Kirbo Crushers — and won.
💓 Brock You Like a Hurricane outlasted 49er Faith-Fool after the favorite flipped 9 times.
